positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior engineer within Cloud Database Engineering team providing Cassandra and Elasticsearch as a service in the cloud at scale.

- Developed anomaly detection for Elasticsearch fleet (consisting of thousands of nodes) base on Rx Java stream processing platform.
- Extended Elasticsearch’s functionality (via plugin architecture) to meet Netflix’s requirements. 
- Contributed to co processes (https://github.com/Netflix/Priam , https://github.com/Netflix/Raigad) use to manage the Cassandra / Elasticsearch fleet.

Technology Used:  Java, AWS, S3, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Rx Java, Guice, Gradle, Jenkins, Git, Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (back-end)
positions.description:
Hightail (formerly YouSendIt) provides file sharing feature for its users.   Developed next generation of file sharing fabric server (i.e. the “download / upload”) by extending Apache Http via module written in C.

Technology Used: Java, C, Apache development, Python
